mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as it reduces the cost of capital and encourages risk-taking in equity markets.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000.0 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns as investors anticipate reduced corporate profits.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below 1000.0 (thousands) in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1000.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward 20-day return as the market prices in a potential recession.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward 20-day returns due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity, but the effect is reversed in easing cycles.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 2.0% in the last month
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as corporate earnings face headwinds from reduced consumer spending.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 6.0% in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as the market anticipates reduced corporate output and profits.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 95.0 (index) in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: During a severe manufacturing contraction (INDPRO < 90.0), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward 20-day returns due to heightened recession risks, but the effect is muted in expansionary supply regimes.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 90.0 (index) in the last month
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO < 90.0, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) consistently supports positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns by indicating a robust labor market that fuels consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS is above 130,000 (thousands).
